specs.name: lengthOfLIS_nonneg
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    lengthOfLIS nums h_precond = 0

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_le_length
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    lengthOfLIS nums h_precond = nums.length

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_pos_of_nonempty
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    nums ≠ [] → lengthOfLIS nums h_precond = 1

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_result_in_allIncreasing
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_result_in_allIncreasing : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), (lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (lengthOfLIS nums h_precond) h_precond)

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_append_large
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums)
    (x : Int) (hx : ∀ n ∈ nums, n = x)
    (h_precond2 : lengthOfLIS_precond (nums ++ [x])),
    lengthOfLIS (nums ++ [x]) h_precond2 = lengthOfLIS nums h_precond + 1

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_sorted_eq_length
specs.stmt: theorem lengthOfLIS_sorted_eq_length : ∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), List.Pairwise (· < ·) nums → lengthOfLIS nums h_precond = nums.length

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (args : List Int) (h : lengthOfLIS_precond args),
    lengthOfLIS_postcond args (lengthOfLIS args h) h

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_perm_invariant
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums1 nums2 : List Int)
    (h1 : lengthOfLIS_precond nums1) (h2 : lengthOfLIS_precond nums2),
    nums1 = nums2 → lengthOfLIS nums1 h1 = lengthOfLIS nums2 h2

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_eq_zero_iff_empty
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    lengthOfLIS nums h_precond = 0 ↔ nums = []

specs.name: lengthOfLIS_is_nat_cast
specs.stmt:
∀ (nums : List Int) (h_precond : lengthOfLIS_precond nums),
    ∃ n : Nat, lengthOfLIS nums h_precond = n
